author: PeterSchiff
text: The 30-year fixed-rate mortgage is now 7.1%. But in 2023, the rate peaked at about 7.8%, despite 10-year Treasury yields being lower than they are now. This is mainly due to Trump ordering the GSEs to buy mortgages, artificially lowering rates, but exposing the GSEs to losses.
